tools.name: check_electric_bill
tools.description: Compare one U.S. household's monthly electricity use and price with similar homes (same state climate, home size, household size, and month). Returns the usage percentile, the typical kWh range, the rate vs. the state or utility average, the dollar gap to a typical home, the estimated share going to

tools.name: get_state_electricity_stats
tools.description: Average residential electricity price (cents per kWh), monthly use, monthly bill, and 1- and 5-year price change for a U.S. state, D.C., or the U.S. overall, over the latest 12 months of EIA data. Omit `state` to get all 50 states and D.C., sorted by price.

tools.name: find_utility_rate
tools.description: Search U.S. electric utilities and retail providers by name or initials (e.g. 'PG&E', 'Oncor', 'Duke Energy') and return each one's average residential price per kWh and customer count from EIA Form 861. These are what residential customers paid on average over the year, not current plan offers.
